title: Generalized Expression (GE) Based on the Generalized Expression Coordinate System (GECS)
content: Academic expression involves diverse approaches to discourse, representation, structure, quality, func-tion, and communication. These approaches provide concrete guidance for particular expression tasks, but a more general framework is needed to position and organize them at a superordinate level. This paper proposes Generalized Expression (GE) based on the Generalized Expression Coordinate System GECS ≡ (EO, EP, ERes), where EO denotes Expression Object, EP Expression Perspective, and ERes Expression Result. GE organizes expression from an expression object, through selected expression perspectives, to a realized expression result, while allowing expression to be further developed when required. GE is not intended to replace concrete writing or communication methods, but to provide a superordinate framework within which such methods may be selected and implemented according to specific expression tasks.
